children.value: > Fact From Story This isn’t Google’s only antitrust case in trial right now.

> Fact From Story The government has argued that Google uses its platforms and deals with partners to block out any competition in search or advertising, thus hindering competitors from accessing the data they’d need to improve their products.
> > Fact From Story The DOJ has been investigating Apple for years over the company’s policy for third-party apps on its devices and whether it unfairly favors its own products.
> > > Fact From Story The FTC sued Amazon in September for using anticompetitive and unfair strategies to illegally maintain its monopoly power.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge Lawsuits and investigations are adversarial.
> > Commonsense Knowledge Investigating a company's policy can lead to a legal case.
> Commonsense Knowledge Antitrust cases involve actions that are believed to be anticompetitive.
